[detail of reservation]: Lithuania has no plans to mark existing civilian bridges with military load class markings in peacetime.
Engineering battalion in the Army of Republic of North Macedonia does not have capacity and abilities for military load classification of bridges, ferries and rafts, only for vehicles.

The reserve consists in the non-existence of personnel specialized in the operation of the reference computer programs, established by the content of the standard, for the calculation of the loading classes of bridges, ferries, transport ports and military vehicles.

[nation]: Note: The reservations listed on this page include only those that were recorded at time of promulgation and may not be complete. Refer to the NATO Standardization Documents Database for the complete list of existing reservations.
